title: Radio airplay by Honey Hancock and Joe Adams
summary: The records got radio play on Honey Hancock's and Joe Adams's shows.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Anyway, I did this date, and we got pretty good exposure. Honey Hancock was playing us on the radio station that he was on. Remember Honey Hancock?
No, he wasn't on KGFJ. He was on another station up here, on Western Avenue and Third.
Right. He went to KGFJ later. Yeah. And Joe Adams was playing these things, and...
KOW, yes, from Santa Monica. Yeah, he had his program out there. And we were getting really good action on these things. They were moving all around, you know.
